# Sun & Sand Sports Complex

> Sun & Sand Sports Complex is a sports and leisure facility on a plot in Jumeirah 1, the coastal Dubai district that runs inland from Jumeirah Beach Road. The area is a low-rise mix of villas, small shopping centres and showrooms, and lies close to the beachfront and to Jumeirah Mosque. Facilities of this kind serve the residents of the surrounding neighbourhoods rather than a citywide catchment.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Jumeirah 1, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

Sun & Sand Sports Complex is a sports complex developed on a plot in Jumeirah 1, one of Dubai's established coastal districts. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the project as subcontractor to Dubai Contracting Company, with Erga Progress Engineering as consultant. The project reflects MENASCO's experience delivering building services for privately owned leisure and commercial facilities.
